note: Set B is a clean, non-redundant set whose claims are all correctly bound and supported, including the three control regions, the DTU pole frequencies/dampings, the 5 rpm minimum speed with its full 3P/tower-frequency condition, and the 7.55 rpm rated speed at 10.59 m/s. Set A covers more ground but adds several duplicates and at least four defective claims: it misbinds 0.03 Hz and 70% damping to 'partial-load pole (pitch controller)' when partial-load poles are the torque controller, and it fabricates quotes ('to avoid the tower/monopile natural frequency', '0° at (TSR)') that do not match the source text. A's extra coverage of the 10.59 m/s rated wind speed and 95 m/s tip speed is real but largely duplicated within A itself, and B also captures the tip speed and rated-speed facts.
